title: Law to allow roadway cafes to operate year-round
summary: This bill would let sidewalk and roadway cafes operate in winter by removing the current seasonal shutdown (previously required from November 30 through March 31) and allowing weatherproofing and winterizing materials. It caps daily café hours so none may run later than 11:00 p.m. or before 10:00 a.m. on Sundays. It also sets license fees of $1,050 per period and a four-year license term.
